run_gif_maker_cli: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate animated gifs from trajectory files
run_parallelize_generation: run parallelized POV-Ray image generation and ffmpeg gif creation from an ASE trajectory file
run_pov_from_atoms: run a single POV-Ray snapshot render of an ASE atoms object with surface replication and bond visualization
refactor_pov_from_atoms: refactor the pov_from_atoms function to customize extra_cells, bounding box, rotation, or texture settings
review_get_parser: review the argparse parser to add or modify CLI arguments for trajectory path, output path, and worker count
